caption_L1: This line chart is titled Number of deaths from drug poisoning by paracetamol in England and Wales from 1993 to 2019. The x-axis shows Year while the y-axis measures Number of deaths.
caption_L2L3: The number of deaths from paracetamol poisoning has reduced between 1993 and 2019 overall. There was a peak in numbers between 1995 and 2000. Numbers have not decreased much between 2010 and 2019. This chart does not show how many of these cases were due to deliberate ingestion of paracetamol.
